summary: AAVE ~$132, +5.4% in 24h. Aave reopened lending markets in stages after freezing 292 reserves when the Binance hacker routed $60M USDT in and borrowed $44.6M WETH; positions stayed fully collateralised and withdrawals never stopped. Buzz is ~2.7x its recent level, but it is hack-driven attention rather than a bullish catalyst, and price has already bounced.
catalyst_note: Aave markets reopened 30 Oct after precautionary freeze; no bad debt reported
